# source: installed imakeidx.sty 1.3e documentation. \makeindex and \index set
# nothing where they stand, as LaTeX's do; the index \printindex prints needs
# makeindex's external run, so it is named and not set.
pre inert:index \makeindex
body impl \index{zz}x
body refuse:W0104 \printindex
pre refuse:W0301 \indexsetup{level=\section}
body refuse:W0301 \indexprologue{x}
